en: Hiding your pet no longer opens the Pomodoro card - the pet just disappears. Bring it back with the tray icon or the shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+P).
id: Menyembunyikan pet tidak lagi membuka kartu Pomodoro - pet langsung menghilang. Panggil kembali lewat ikon tray atau pintasan (Ctrl+Alt+P).
zh_TW: 隱藏寵物時不再跳出番茄鐘卡片 - 寵物直接消失。可用系統匣圖示或快捷鍵（Ctrl+Alt+P）叫回來。
zh_CN: 隐藏宠物时不再弹出番茄钟卡片 - 宠物直接消失。可用系统托盘图标或快捷键（Ctrl+Alt+P）叫回来。
